Cybernetic ribs, joints, housings, barrels, cables and dorsal module remain silver/gunmetal/chrome-matte with small dark cavities and restrained yellow-black hazard markings. No whole-body whitening or neon wash.
designDetails.surface: Keep wet organic ribs, jaws, limb tissue and tail segmentation visibly distinct from hard machined plates, pistons, cables, cannon blocks and cylindrical barrels. Re-author every detail; do not lift the screenshot's pixels, lighting, room or pose.
designDetails.anatomy: A complete Xenomorph base remains readable beneath augmentation: one eyeless skull with jaws, one ribbed torso, two legs and exactly one long segmented tail. Both biological arms terminate in integrated weapon grafts rather than human hands holding a gun. No human face, clothing or fully enclosed mech body.
designDetails.equipment: Cranial targeting hardware; exactly two permanent forearm laser-cannon block assemblies with long cylindrical barrels; restrained hazard markings; one rectangular dorsal power module with vertical cylinders and connected cabling. These are fused anatomy/equipment and never detach or become a handheld rifle.
designDetails.orientation: Strict orthographic gameplay side profile facing RIGHT in all 40 poses. The near cannon and its flesh-metal junction are fully readable; the far graft remains structurally consistent and may be partially occluded as correct side-profile depth, never exposed by a three-quarter torso turn. Skull, module, both graft identities, feet and complete tail remain inside their cells.
